name: B10-0183/2024 (S&D) – Georgia's worsening democratic crisis following the recent parliamentary elections and alleged electoral fraud
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Georgia’s worsening democratic crisis following the recent parliamentary elections and alleged electoral fraud
part_text:
The European Parliament says Georgia's October 2024 parliamentary elections were not free and fair. It points to voter intimidation, pressure on public workers, vote buying and a big spending advantage for the ruling party. It asks Georgia to investigate all complaints, including through an independent international inquiry. It also backs new elections in a fairer environment once a fact-finding mission reports. The text is the Parliament's position and request; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament asks for an independent international inquiry and possible new elections in Georgia.
- **Who it affects:** Georgia's government, election bodies, parties and voters, plus the EU's stance and aid.
- **What happens next:** A fact-finding mission goes to Georgia; the EU keeps supporting civil society and independent media.
